json_data.notes: Contains serialized JSON with allListings array

notes: JavaScript-rendered React application using Astro Islands. Listing data is embedded in the page as serialized JSON in the 'props' attribute of the astro-island component. Requires JavaScript execution (Playwright/Selenium) to render the actual listing cards, OR custom parser to decode the serialized props data. The props attribute contains encoded JSON with fields: id, title, location, listing_price, sales, cash_flow, type, full_address, city, state, postal_code, content, square_footage, seating, concept, parking, licenses, hours, lease_terms, and more. Each listing has a slug that can be used to construct detail page URLs like: /listings/{slug}/. Multiple active listings found in the data including restaurants, bars, and other F&B businesses primarily in Massachusetts.
